directives.reason: The three decline criteria demand an absolute 15pp revenue drop that the story only supports as a relative growth slowdown between stable and reassigned accounts, which is unreachable via the current check and re-expressible as a differential check of the same claim.
directives.guidance: AC1/AC2/AC3 all require a post-change revenue decline of at least 15 percentage points via check=post_change_revenue_decline, but the tuning loop cannot produce a 15pp decline in post-change revenue (worst margin -6.81). The story says growth was 'materially weaker' after ownership change, not that post-change revenue itself fell by 15pp. RE-EXPRESS these three criteria to the reachable form of the same claim: measure the growth differential between stable-owner and reassigned accounts (the slowdown tracked churn, i.e. a relative gap in expansion rate), rather than an absolute decline in post-change revenue. Use check=elasticity_differential or an equivalent differential check with a min_gap_pp that the story supports (the story's own contrast is stable-vs-reassigned, which AC4 already targets at 10pp). Do not weaken below what the story supports; express the slowdown as a differential, not an impossible absolute decline.
